meaning.en: (medicine) The drug chlortetracycline, obtained from Streptomyces aureofaciens bacteria.
meaning.vi: (y học) Thuốc chlortetracycline, thu được từ vi khuẩn Streptomyces aureofaciens.

sentences.en: After afterwards penicillin, discovered streptomycin, chloromycetin, aureomycin to wait in succession again.

sentences.en: Dietary chicken egg - yolk antibodies or aureomycin supplementation could improved serum IGF - I levels of meat ducks.

sentences.en: The Marines were treated with an early antibiotic, Aureomycin , in capsules to be swallowed the size of the first joint of a man's finger.

sentences.en: Methods 78 eyes of 46 cases with ulcerative blepharitis were treated with ethyl green alcohol plus oculentum aureomycin (Group A) or ocustilla zinc sulfate plus oculentum aureomycin (Group B).
sentences.vi: Phương pháp 78 mắt trong số 46 trường hợp bị viêm bờ mi bị loét được điều trị bằng cồn xanh etylic cộng với oculentum aureomycin (Nhóm A) hoặc ocustilla kẽm sulfat cộng với oculentum aureomycin (Nhóm B).

sentences.en: She had something wrong with her ear and her aural surgeon gave her some aureomycin.
